ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobes contrasted against 25% low-intensity black pixels located at the perimeters, trailing edges, and internal spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe features a large contiguous white region with dense vertical black streaks in the lower-central quadrant and a thick, irregular black border. The right lobe presents a predominantly white field punctuated by approximately 10-12 discrete, high-contrast dark circular and ovoid spots distributed throughout the distal half.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 45-55 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular serrations with several deep indentations. The right trailing edge shows lower-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along a more continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trajectory is concave originating from the median notch, transitioning into a convex curve towards the sharply pointed and upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Right lobe displays a distinct cluster of dark circular pixel groups (scars) on the white background. Left lobe tip shows small, white circular high-contrast rings situated within the black pigmentation of the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Left lobe exhibits multiple prominent dark vertical linear streaks and two distinct intersecting linear marks in the lower quadrant forming an inverted 'V' or 'X' shape.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular tissue loss and jagged notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe; prominent vertical linear scarring across the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique sparse 'polka-dot' pigmentation pattern localized specifically to the white field of the right lobe.
